page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8y.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the ARM64 architecture. It features a custom Alibaba YiTian710 processor operating at 2.75 GHz, providing 64 dedicated physical cores without simultaneous multithreading (64 vCPUs at 1 thread per core). The system integrates 128.0 GB of memory, yielding a 1:2 compute-optimized core-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware cache provisions include 64 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a shared 64 MB L3 cache. Cryptographic hardware acceleration is present via AES extensions. The instance has no integrated local storage and contains no discrete GPUs, relying on remote network-attached block storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps under the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong parallel throughput across compute and in-memory operations. While single-core performance ranks in the average range, as seen in stress-ng single-core (1815.1) and gzip compression (28.68 GB/sec), multi-threaded scaling is in the top 25%, with stress-ng multi-core achieving 114685.05 and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression hitting 486.63 GB/sec. Memory subsystems register exceptional efficiency, marked by a top-tier PassMark memory score of 3017.93 and cached read bandwidth of 6476.63 GB/sec. Large-block uncached read and write bandwidths measure 128.75 GB/sec and 64.46 GB/sec, respectively. In-memory data structures perform reliably well, indicated by Redis SET throughput reaching 94.6 million operations per second and strong PassMark database operation scores (27691.53).

Given its ARM-based architecture and 1:2 memory ratio, ecs.c8y.16xlarge provides strong resource density and computational cost efficiency for horizontally scalable multi-core workloads. However, applications requiring x86 instruction extensions or massive memory footprints may experience bottlenecks due to the absence of AVX instructions and the limited 2.0 GB per core allocation. The instance is suited for multi-threaded batch processing, high-throughput caching tiers, distributed web serving, and database services optimized for ARM64 platforms.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8y.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the 64-core ARM64 Alibaba YiTian710 processor running at 2.75 GHz. Designed with a 1:2 memory allocation, it features 128.0 GB of RAM (2.0 GB per dedicated physical core), 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, no GPUs, and no bundled local storage. In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates strong multi-threaded compute and memory performance, registering a top-tier PassMark memory score of 3017.93, high multi-core stress-ng throughput, and 94.6 million Redis SET operations per second. Single-threaded metrics and uncached memory bandwidth align within average bands. With its power-efficient ARM core density, ecs.c8y.16xlarge delivers cost-efficient multi-threaded compute capacity, making it appropriate for parallel processing, high-density web tiers, Redis caching layers, and ARM64-native database workloads.
